verdict.rationale: Fathom exposes a documented REST API with self-serve API-key generation, dedicated endpoints for transcripts and summaries, and webhook payloads that can include transcript/summary/action items, plus official SDKs and a live runtime-verified API surface with OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: a clearly documented standalone REST 'get action items' endpoint (action items appear only bundled via webhook payloads) and independent (non-vendor) developer corroboration.
